records.statement: Visual Office design handoff registration accepts the pinned bounded v1 package for an authorized Business Workspace, validates its graph and GLB bytes, and atomically stores immutable design revisions, server-issued identity crosswalks, content-addressed assets, idempotent commit results and scoped audit under expected-version and current ownership fences. Floor, role, agent-design and workflow records remain design data and grant no runtime Agent, approval, domain or permission. Private reads return only committed scoped mappings and bytes.
